definition.hypothesis: Outgoing RUM session baggage reads the mutable Trace receiver instead of the supplied request-time NetworkContext, while completion-created URLSession spans capture later RUM application/session/view/action IDs. Source-less requests may be attributed to the wrong owner or adopt RUM after starting without it.
definition.red: Exactly 13 new unit tests: eight predicted ownership failures and five preservation passes. Freeze exact assertion predicates, sources and all test files before execution. Baseline APIs only; pass optional captured states without requiring a new private shape.
definition.private_test_maintenance: In three existing handler tests only, replace capturedState == nil with optional activeSpan == nil and hasGraphQLHeaders == false checks. Preserve every existing header, parent, trace and sampling assertion. Freeze these replacements before baseline.
definition.ownership_contract: Present NetworkContext owns its optional RUM value, including authoritative nil. Absent NetworkContext preserves request-time Trace receiver fallback, captured once. At completion, absence of a map entry preserves legacy writer behavior; a present wrapper containing nil removes later RUM context.
definition.compatibility_contract: Keep makeElementsForNewSpanContext and both existing sampling call paths unchanged, including networkContext?.rumContext ?? receiver fallback. Keep existing userId/accountId expressions and header overwrite policy. Only RUM additional context changes; serialized non-RUM context stays completion-time. Preserve manual spans, consent, parent/GraphQL behavior and cancellation error spans.
definition.conditional_fix: Only after exact baseline red and independent review: add optional RUM value to existing captured state, always return it; use a value-only wrapper keyed by interception UUID and one atomic removal before all completion guards. Internal writer override replaces/removes only RUM additional context in both span branches. Internal startSpan writer parameter defaults to the unchanged manual-span writer.
definition.lifetime: One captured entry per existing retained interception; production start is first-only and finish calls every handler before removing its interception. No task/interception/scope reference in the new map. Recoverable guard table (tracer, timing, completion, origin) retries same interception under B and must see legacy B, proving prior capture was consumed. Immutable third-party guard has no-output plus source-order proof. No immediate-unbind, hard capacity or measured footprint claim; existing missing-metrics retention and dictionary high-water capacity remain limitations.
definition.green: Complete DatadogTrace target once, identical frozen tests, zero unexpected failures or skips; retain compiler/runtime diagnostics. Existing writer context/consent and manual span tests are included in that target.
definition.native: Three identical native tests per arm: two new automatic Trace-only URLSession tests plus unchanged testParentSpanPropagation. Trace URLSession tracking is enabled; RUM manual views/actions have urlSessionTracking nil, so serialized urlsession.request SpanEvents are exercised rather than backend-created RUM-resource spans. Held A/B requests complete B then A; a request started before RUM activation cannot adopt later RUM IDs. Assert actual captured outgoing headers, caller headers, exact serialized span counts/owners/trace IDs and completion-time non-RUM context. The existing parent control passes on both arms. No backend claim.
definition.native_expected: Baseline exactly two failing ownership tests and one passing existing parent control; candidate three pass. Freeze exact failure locations after source review and before either native invocation. Custom URLProtocol must provide real start/hold/release/completion receipts and finite waits, never invent metrics.
definition.environment: Xcode 27.1/27A9269; booted iPad iOS17.5/21F79 simulator. Hostless units then Example-hosted native integration. Main MCP active Example has no tests; use explicit isolated CLI schemes and preserve IDE state. No credentials.
definition.inputs: Fresh derived/results directories, frozen tracked sources and tests, verified package pins/checkouts and 142 framework records. Disable package updates/automatic resolution. Preserve both main protected paths by metadata/hash policy. Root alone controls builds/devices.
definition.diagnostics: Symmetric -collect-test-diagnostics never preserves assertions, console/results and sanitizer configuration while omitting verbose archives/sysdiagnoses. No clean-sanitizer claim.
definition.bound: 90 minutes absolute from definition; one 13-test red, one full Trace green, one three-test native invocation per arm. Each invocation at most 1200 seconds, shortened to reserve cleanup before the deadline; native pair at most 2400 seconds. Stop on compile failure, unexpected oracle, timeout or input drift. Any specific correction requires separately recorded review; no retry-until-green.
definition.cleanup: Prove test/host process and Example app absence, live device binding and protected metadata unchanged. Original seven-hour caffeinate has expired; no renewal admitted.
